findings: One finding that is no test failure and breaks no gate, for the reviewer rather than a round back: the six changelog fragments this change adds are named `packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/INFRA-714-<slug>.yaml`. The repository's AGENTS.md rule for changelog fragments says 'No Dispatch issue key goes in the file name, in the `Issue` field or in the body', and names the form `pr<number>-<slug>.yaml` — here `pr2539-<slug>.yaml`. The bodies and the absent `Issue` field are already clean; only the six file names carry the key, and they would land on main permanently. Nothing enforces it: `.github/scripts/check-private-names.sh` passes over the whole tree (6702 files, exit 0, so `INFRA-714` is not in the private-names class), `changeFormat` in packages/daemon/.changie.yaml renders from `.Body` alone so a hand-written fragment with no `Custom.Issue` folds correctly, `fragmentFileFormat` governs only `changie new`, and `release-push.sh fold-plan` correctly lists none of the six because no release ships them yet. A rename of six files, which the reviewer can make itself as a prose-only fix.
